text:
Alex Park: Quick status — vendor called, ETA for the H100 pallet shifted from 2026-03-25 to 2026-04-02 due to customs docs. Impact: canary nodes for us-west-2 slip ~1 week.
Talia Chen: Ugh. Any chance we can split the shipment so we can still get a subset earlier?
Alex Park: Asked that. Vendor says split is possible but costs + transit time will be similar; need PO amendment. I'll ping procurement.
Ben Patel: If we lose one week, can we move some capacity from eu-central to us-west for the canary window? Who owns the region reservations?
Sofia Martinez: I own the eu reservations, but shifting will require a reservation swap in the cloud console + infra approval. That needs 24h at least.
Alex Park: Ok — plan A: amend PO for partial air-split (cost TBD) and start swap prep in case. Plan B: accept 1-week slip and keep eu canary. Need decision by EOD today.
Talia Chen: For the swap prep, @Sofia can you add the exact steps? Ben, can you confirm if the canary test harness tolerates mixed-region latency?
Sofia Martinez: Steps: 1) open ticket CHG-4522, 2) update reservation policy in infra-reservations (see snippet), 3) run node re-homing script. Snippet: ```
# swap reservation
reservation_id=res-2026-03-16-usw2
target_region=eu-central-1
apply_drain=true
```
Ben Patel: Can confirm harness will run across regions but tests that assume 8ms p95 will fail; need to toggle tolerances in test config (I can PR).
Alex Park: @infra-bot can you attach current reservation counts for us-west-2 and eu-central-1?
infra-bot: automated update — us-west-2: reserved 42/100 (dedicated), eu-central-1: reserved 28/80 (dedicated). See dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/reservations
Talia Chen: Cost question — if procurement does the split, what's the delta? Procurement said +12% on shipping and handling. Can finance sign off?
Alex Park: I'll loop in finance if we choose split. For now, everyone: please ack if you can be on standby for a swap tonight. Need 1 engineer from infra, 1 from platform, 1 from ml.
Ben Patel: ack — I can be on platform standby. :thumbsup:
Sofia Martinez: ack — infra standby. I'll open CHG-4522 and drop steps + runbook there.
Talia Chen: ack — ml standby, will adjust test tolerances if we swap.
Alex Park: Thanks all. Updating the project board now and will post final decision by 17:00 PT.
Sofia Martinez: (added) CHG-4522 created: https://tickets.redwood.ai/CHG-4522 — attaching cable/power checklist and owner tags.
infra-bot: note — reservation policy change requires 2 approvals: infra-sre and platform-ops.
Alex Park: noted. Will request approvals once PO decision is made. :white_check_mark:
